summary: Official registration and certificate issuance for newborn children within 21 days of birth.
estimated_total_cost: ₹0 within 21 days; ₹10–₹50 late fee up to 1 year

steps.title: Hospital discharge institutional report
steps.description: Collect Form 1 institutional report generated by hospital/maternity nursing home.

steps.title: Submit child's name online
steps.description: Log in to Civil Registration System (CRS) portal and register baby's official name.

steps.title: Verification by Registrar
steps.description: Municipal birth registrar verifies institutional logs against hospital registers.

steps.title: Download digital birth certificate
steps.description: Download digitally signed Birth Certificate with national QR code; download unlimited copies free.
